record.title: Select the next initialization region or ambiguity after SPU
record.intent: Use static recovery and observed divergence to choose the smallest useful successor.
requirements: Evaluate SPU selector and operand agreement without treating image defaults or synthetic acceptance as hardware behavior.
Consider WPU SCU UART GD32 and LA as a region with explicit mutable inputs and transport boundaries, not one experiment per deterministic store.
Recover any intervening read or transport consumer before introducing another synthetic response; replan explicitly on mismatch.
acceptance: Justify and admit a bounded successor or report a concrete blocker; commit and push before another experiment.
